finalText: All green! The issue was in the `orderTotal` function at line 41 of `src/pricing.js`. It was calculating tax on the original price instead of the discounted price. Tax should only apply to what the customer actually pays after the discount is applied. Changed `const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);` to `const tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate);` and all 625 tests now pass.
